nodes.label: Order Idempotency (idempotency_key + SHA-256 payload hash)
nodes.rationale: Exactly-once order creation under flaky mobile Wi-Fi retries; same key+hash returns 200, altered payload returns 409.

nodes.label: ADR-004: Server-Side Payload Hash
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth: client sends only idempotency_key; same key with different payload returns 409.

nodes.label: Deterministic Allergen Safety Engine
nodes.rationale: Allergies can be life-threatening; set operations against EU-14 avoid generative AI hallucinations. Orders with contains/unverified items require explicit acknowledgment.

nodes.label: ADR-005: Allergen Status Precedence (contains > unverified > no_declared_match)
nodes.norm_label: adr-005: allergen status precedence (contains > unverified > no_declared_match)
nodes.rationale: Overlap yields contains regardless of verification; precedence pinned in shared test vectors.

nodes.label: Air-Gapped Privacy Design
nodes.rationale: Free LLM tiers may train on prompts, so only synthetic business data is sent; guest personal data and allergy profiles never reach LLMs.

nodes.label: Role-Separated Signed Cookies (mise_guest/mise_owner/mise_staff)
nodes.rationale: Role-isolated sessions signed with HMAC-SHA256 (API_SECRET_KEY); guest uses SameSite=Lax for QR scan transitions, owner/staff Strict.

nodes.label: ADR-001: Same-Origin Proxy (No CORS)
nodes.rationale: Next.js rewrites to FastAPI remove CORS and make cookies same-origin; trade-off is possible SSE buffering, mitigated by /debug/sse, raised timeouts and Caddy fallback.

nodes.rationale: Next 16 may replace rewrites with proxy.ts; stay on ~15 until migration is planned.
